SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D
Date December 4, 1934

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date December 4, 1934

Subject (in full) Prevention of influx of bad characters into Shanghai --
interview with Dr. Hung Chi.

Made by. D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the endorsement of the Deputy Commissioner
(Special Branch) on the attached translation of a leading
article from "SLOVO" of November 15, 1934, on the subject of
influx into Shanghai of bad characters from Harbin, I have to
report that a copy of the translation in question was passed
through the medium of Supt. Tan Shao Liang to Dr. Hung Chi,
Chief of the 2nd Division of the Public Safety Bureau, under
whose control is the Passport Examination Office.

Interviewed by the undersigned on December 3, Dr. Hung
Chi stated that he fully realised the seriousness of the
situation and pointed out that prevention of the influx of
undesirable elements into Shanghai was a complicated problem
which required co-operation of the three police forces in
Shanghai. Therefore, should the Public Safety Bureau receive
an official communication on the subject from the Shanghai
Municipal Police, Dr. Hung Chi would suggest that a conference
be held by representatives of the Municipal, French, and City
Police Forces to devise measures to be adopted in this
connection.

G Prokofiev
D. S. I.

Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch.

（左侧边注：re forward of letter ... of for）

52.
Please let me know if there is a
system for the registration of foreigners in force
in Manchukuo and how it works. [签名]
D.S. Umemoto.
S&R 6/12 DEC. 4 1934

制作人：副督察普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）。转呈人 [签名]

关于副处长（特务科）在附件中1934年11月15日《斯洛沃报》（SLOVO）社论译文上的批注，该社论涉及哈尔滨不良分子涌入上海一事，兹报告如下：上述译文副本已通过谭绍良（Tan Shao Liang，音译）巡官转交给公安局第二处处长洪基（Hung Chi，音译）博士，护照查验处即在其管辖之下。

12月3日，具名人在访谈洪基（Hung Chi，音译）博士时，他表示充分认识到局势的严重性，并指出防止不良分子涌入上海是一个复杂的问题，需要上海三支警察力量的合作。因此，如果公安局收到来自上海公共租界工部局警务处关于此事的正式公函，洪基（Hung Chi，音译）博士将建议由工部局、法租界及华界警察局的代表举行会议，以此制定相关应对措施。

G 普罗科菲耶夫
副督察

page_data.en:
Translation of leading article which appeared in "SLOVO"
of November 15, 1934.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

HARBIN "STARS" COMING TO SHANGHAI.

Life of the Russian community in Shanghai is getting
complicated. Along with the increasing number of respectable
people who come here in quest of employment or in order to
establish a business, many political chameleons, disguised
communists and, of course, many criminals find their way into
this city.

For individuals of the latter category there is almost
nothing to do in Harbin at present. Every one of them is
well known there, the objects of their "experiments" are
impoverished and punishments are very severe in Harbin.
Therefore Shanghai presents a great temptation to Harbin
criminal elements.

Certain persons who recently arrived here from Harbin
and who know well the underworld of that city, as they had
been engaged for many years in combatting it, state that the
present slogan of Harbin criminal elements is "Let's go to
Shanghai".

It must be noted that during the course of this year
certain disorderly elements, who arrived in Shanghai from
various places, have brought about a distinct and very
unpleasant change in the general style of our life here.

Senseless street brawls, stabbing affairs and scandals
of every description are frequent occurrences now, while
formerly cases of this nature were totally unknown in Shanghai.

In the daily chronicle of scandalous occurrences the
disorderly elements who arrived in Shanghai recently, play
a predominant part. The local underworld was also
reinforced by Harbin criminal elements in the course of
the past few years. Should more of them come here, the
Russian community will feel the unpleasant consequences.
page_data.zh:
1934年11月15日《斯洛沃报》（SLOVO）刊登的社论译文。
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

哈尔滨“明星”来到上海。

上海俄侨社区的生活正变得复杂起来。随着越来越多体面人士为求职或经商而来此，许多政治变色龙、伪装的共产主义者，当然还有许多罪犯，也混入了这座城市。

对于后一类人而言，目前在哈尔滨几乎无事可做。他们在那里都为人所熟知，其“实验”对象已贫困潦倒，且哈尔滨的惩罚极为严厉。因此，上海对哈尔滨的犯罪元素构成了巨大的诱惑。

某些最近从哈尔滨抵达此地的人，因多年从事打击该市黑社会的工作而对其 underworld 十分了解，他们称哈尔滨犯罪元素目前的口号是“去上海”。

必须指出，在今年期间，某些从各地抵达上海的捣乱分子，已使我们这里的一般生活风格发生了明显且非常令人不快的变化。

无意义的街头斗殴、持刀伤人事件以及各种丑闻如今频繁发生，而此类案件以前在上海是完全未知的。

在日常的丑闻记录中，最近抵达上海的捣乱分子占据了主要地位。在过去几年中，哈尔滨的犯罪元素也加强了本地的黑社会势力。如果有更多这样的人来到这里，俄侨社区将感受到不愉快的后果。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

We presume that the local authorities are fully aware
of this danger and will adopt appropriate measures in order to
put an end to a further influx of criminal elements into this
city and will tighten their control over the local underworld.
If, nevertheless, more criminals come to Shanghai, an increase
in crime can certainly be anticipated. This is a problem which
calls for a careful consideration.

The best solution of the problem would be the establish-
ment by the police forces of the three municipalities of an
information service with a view to preventing influx of
criminals in Shanghai, no matter where from and by what route
they arrive here.

In this respect the Russian community can do little,
as measures of this nature come within the competency of police
and judicial organs. But in the struggle against hooliganism
and disorderly conduct, we are in a position to render
assistance to the authorities as well as to guard our own
interests.

Not a single case of hooliganism should remain unexposed.
Apart from rendering assistance to the authorities in this
respect, we must adopt a definite and firm attitude towards
disorderly elements in our midst. Strict rules should be worked
out in order to exclude these elements from our midst. In a
hostile atmosphere individuals of the above mentioned category
will soon cease to indulge in their favourite "sport", such as
street fighting, stabbing affairs etc. with which the bulk of
the local Russian community has nothing in common.

The struggle against the influx in Shanghai of political
chameleons, agents-provocateurs and communists is much more
difficult, especially taking into consideration our unpardonably
lenient attitude towards such people. From this side, many
unpleasant and painful surprises may be anticipated, especially
under the present difficult situation. We have to be very
cautious when admitting into our midst persons whose political
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

我们推测地方当局完全意识到这一危险，并将采取适当措施，以阻止犯罪元素进一步涌入本市，并加强对本地黑社会的控制。尽管如此，如果仍有更多罪犯来到上海，犯罪率的增加是可以预见的。这是一个需要仔细考虑的问题。

解决该问题的最佳方案是由三个市政当局的警察部队建立情报服务，以防止罪犯无论从何地、经由何种路线涌入上海。

在这方面，俄侨社区能做的很少，因为此类措施属于警察和司法机关的职权范围。但在反对流氓行为和扰乱治安的斗争中，我们既能够协助当局，也能维护自身利益。

任何一起流氓行为都不应被掩盖。除了在此方面协助当局外，我们必须对我们中间的捣乱分子采取明确且坚定的态度。应制定严格的规则，将这些分子排除出我们的群体。在敌对的氛围中，上述类别的个人将很快不再沉溺于他们喜爱的“运动”，如街头斗殴、持刀伤人等，而这些行为与当地大多数俄侨社区毫无共同之处。

反对政治变色龙、挑衅代理人和共产主义者涌入上海的斗争要困难得多，特别是考虑到我们对这类人不可原谅的宽容态度。由此方面，可能会预期出现许多不愉快和痛苦的意外，特别是在目前的困难局势下。我们在接纳政治

page_data.en:

past has not been chequed on, and to exercise a greater
vigilance in respect of new-comers.
All this, of course, is an unavoidable consequence
of the general situation, which it is beyond our power to
change. Nevertheless, we feel that we must give a timely
warning, as all cases of breach of peace and order on the
part of disorderly elements who have nothing in common with
the bulk of the local Russian community, will be utilized
in order to bring discredit on the community as a whole.

D.S. S.B.

背景未经核查的人员进入我们中间时必须非常谨慎，并对新来者保持更高的警惕。
当然，所有这一切都是我们无法改变的总体局势的不可避免后果。尽管如此，我们认为必须及时发出警告，因为那些与当地大多数俄侨社区毫无共同之处的捣乱分子所引发的破坏和平与秩序的案件，将被利用来使整个社区蒙羞。

China Evening News :-

RESTRICTION OF CHINESE EMIGRANTS TO SINGAPORE

As too large numbers of Chinese workers are
arriving at Singapore and only a few are able to find
work, the Singapore Government intends to restrict the
entry of all labourers as from August this year.

China Evening News :-

REGISTRATION OF RUSSIANS ARRIVING IN SHANGHAI

Russians arriving in Shanghai are required to
register with the Bureau of Public Safety within ten days
of their arrival.
Up to the present, only 17,330 Russians have
registered. We learn that the Bureau has requested the
Association of Russian Residents in Shanghai to persuade
Russians to comply with the law.
The Bureau will request the French Police and
the S.M.P. for information regarding the Russian popula-
tion in Shanghai.
Train or steamer tickets will not be sold
to Russians who are provided with passports issued by
the Bureau.

China Times :-

TRADING IN JAPANESE COTTON TO BE RESUMED
AUGUST 1
At the request of Funatsu, President of the
Japanese Cotton Mill Owners Association of Shanghai, the
Chinese Cotton Goods Exchange, Avenue Edward VII, has
decided to resume transactions in Japanese cotton thread
as from August 1 this year.
The Exchange has convoked a meeting of experts
at 4 p.m. July 26 to examine the quality of Japanese
cotton thread. Japanese experts will also be in attendance.

Star Daily News :-

CRITICISM OF FRENCH EMPLOYEES OF SEMAPHORE STATION

The rise or drop in temperature is a matter
closely connected with the health of the human being. Every
day, numerous persons call at the semaphore station to seek
information about the weather, but the French employees of
the semaphore have adopted an attitude of "No Reply" and
refuse to give out any information. This shows that the
French people care nothing about the health of the
people.

1935年7月25日下午译文。

大量被拘留的无辜民众将获得释放，从而缓解我们监狱的拥挤状况。

《China Evening News》（中国晚报）：

限制中国移民前往新加坡

由于抵达新加坡的中国工人数量过多，而仅有少数人能找到工作，新加坡政府打算从今年8月起限制所有劳工入境。

《China Evening News》（中国晚报）：

抵沪俄国人登记

抵达上海的俄国人须在抵达后十天内向公安局登记。
截至目前，仅有17,330名俄国人进行了登记。据悉，该局已请求上海俄国居民协会劝说俄国人遵守法律。
该局将向法国警察局和上海公共租界工部局警务处索取有关上海俄国人口的信息。
持有该局签发护照的俄国人将无法购买火车或轮船票。

《China Times》（时报）：

8月1日恢复日本棉花交易

应上海日本棉纺厂主协会会长船津（Funatsu，音译）的请求，位于爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）的中国棉业交易所决定从今年8月1日起恢复日本棉纱交易。
交易所已于7月26日下午4时召开专家会议，审查日本棉纱的质量。日本专家也将出席。

《Star Daily News》（星日报）：

对信号站法国雇员的批评

气温的升降与人类健康密切相关。每天，许多人前往信号站查询天气信息，但信号站的法国雇员采取了“不予答复”的态度，拒绝提供任何信息。这表明法国人毫不关心民众的健康。

REPORT
Date December 12 / 19 34.

Subject (in full) Prevention of influx of bad characters into Shanghai --
registration of foreigners in Manchoukuo.
Made by... D. S. Umemoto. Forwarded by

With reference to the endorsement of the Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch, on the attached report of December 4 on the
subject of the registration of foreigners in Manchoukuo, I
have to state that information regarding the working of a
system for the registration of foreigners being enforced in
Manchoukuo is not available locally.

It is learned that the local Japanese Consular Police
have requested the Japanese Ambassador to Manchoukuo to furnish
information regarding arrivals of foreigners in Manchoukuo from
Soviet Russia and departures from Manchoukuo for China as well
as particulars concerning their passports, movements, etc.
Should this request be complied with by the Japanese authorities
in Manchoukuo, the movements in Manchoukuo of bad characters,
either criminally or politically, will be obtainable from the
local Japanese Consulate.

A list of some 554 Russian and Chinese criminals who have
been recently released in Harbin, Manchuli and other places
in Manchoukuo by virtue of amnesty has been obtained by the
local Japanese Consular Police on behalf of the Deputy Commissioner,
Crime Branch, and is being kept in the Municipal Police Registry.

（左侧批注：x Crime Br. Registry）

D. S. Umemoto.
D. S.

制作人... 副督察梅本（Umemoto）。转呈人

关于副处长（特务科）在附件12月4日有关满洲国外国人登记报告的批注，兹声明如下：目前本地无法获得关于满洲国正在实施的外国人登记制度运作情况的信息。

据悉，本地日本领事警察已请求日本驻满洲国大使提供有关外国人从苏联俄罗斯抵达满洲国以及从满洲国前往中国的入境信息，以及有关其护照、行踪等的详细情况。如果满洲国的日本当局满足这一请求，则可从本地日本领事馆获取不良分子（无论是刑事还是政治性质）在满洲国的行踪信息。

一份包含约554名最近在满洲国哈尔滨、满洲里及其他地方因大赦获释的俄国和中国罪犯的名单，已由本地日本领事警察代表刑事科副处长获取，并存放在工部局警务处登记处。

（左侧批注：x 刑事科登记处）

D. S. 梅本。
副督察。

副处长，特务科。
